reuse.why: Puts the new rule into the existing getScheduledAmount and calls it from three sites, but only for the range branch while the helper already handles missing and numeric amounts.

duplication.why: The missing/number/range ternary is kept at updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, duplicating the dispatch getScheduledAmount already does.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, where the tree keeps it.

scope.why: Small, focused diff: the helper, three call sites, comments and a test.

maintainability.why: The rule is defined once, but forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and schedule-template.ts still compute their own midpoint, so planning paths disagree and a maintainer must hunt for copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList keep their own midpoint copy instead of calling getScheduledAmount; the three updated sites keep their own null/number dispatch around it.

disguised_duplication.where: The retained ternaries are the original code with only the range branch replaced; nothing is renamed or reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount holds the new rule, but forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and schedule-template.ts createScheduleList still apply the old rounded-midpoint rule on their own.
